questions.question:
Select the option that corrects the following sentence.

All the workers have called of the strike.

options.text: All the workers have called at the strike.
All the workers have called through the strike.
All the workers have called between the strike.
All the workers have called off the strike.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '4' i.e. "All the workers have called off the strike."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence uses** "called of"** instead of the correct phrasal verb "called off."
 
• The phrasal verb** "call off"** means to cancel or stop something that was planned, like a strike.
 
• Option 4, **"called off the strike,"** is grammatically correct and fits well in the sentence.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

Correct sentence: *All the workers have called off the strike.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "called at the strike," and Option 2, "called through the strike," do not make sense in the context of cancelling a strike.
 
• Option 3, "called between the strike," is also incorrect as it does not logically convey the meaning of stopping the strike.

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

He organises / a children’s fair every year / and his friends comes / to attend it.
questions.solution:
The segment with a grammatical error is ‘3’ i.e. and his friends comes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The segment "**and his friends comes**" is incorrect because of subject-verb agreement.
 
• The word "**friends**" is plural, so the correct verb form should be "come" instead of "comes."
 
• The corrected segment should read "and his friends come."

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *He organises a children’s fair every year, and his friends come to attend it.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1,** "He organises," is correct with the British English spelling of "organises."
 
• **Option 2**, "to attend it," is grammatically correct and contextually appropriate.
 
• **Option 4, **"a children’s fair every year," is also correct and does not contain any grammatical errors.
 
• Proper subject-verb agreement is essential for maintaining grammatical accuracy in sentences.

• **Example:** The paucity of water in the region has led to severe drought conditions.
